decision: Spatial curvature high-pass susceptibility; reject strict zero-background and adaptive D_star.

physics_rule.absolute_precursor: D_reg from regularized inverse-square finite-source response
physics_rule.far_tail: S kernel scales as r^-4 and is infrared integrable in 3D

preregistration_constraints: No adaptive threshold or post-data environmental rescaling.
No temporal high-pass: static source masses remain physically active.
Ambient Earth and apparatus enter only through curvature of D_reg.
Any non-negligible calculated ambient curvature must be included before fitting data.
